findings.statement: The production experience never progressed beyond the WebGL 2 unavailable alert across entry and three visible reload attempts.
Because no chooser, world, controls, objective, ending, or replay affordance became visible, none of the five scenario tasks could be completed in this browser environment.
Provide a working supported-browser path or a recovery/fallback that can progress beyond graphics initialization, then rerun the complete first-user scenario.
